purpose: Teach: 歓声/一節/サントラ/裏話/夜行/見栄え/新春/旅客機

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、運動会で、本気で、絶対、歓声、絶対、聞こえたわ
lines.en: Sho, I really heard everyone cheering for you at the sports day. Seriously.
lines.style: Warm, bright opening. Direct eye contact. Fast pace with small pauses between thoughts. Voice lifting on the praise. Genuine excitement without performing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、好きな歌の、絶対、一節、絶対、覚えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually memorized a whole verse from my favorite song. Like, all of it.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Slight acceleration as he reaches the payoff. Not bragging — offering something he's made to someone he trusts. Small satisfied breath at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、サントラ、絶対、メイ姉さんも、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: That's amazing, Sho. You know, I really love that soundtrack too.
lines.style: Soft, genuine tone. Leaning in slightly — meeting him where he is. Warm without making a big moment of it. Slow, deliberate pacing on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、好きなYouTuberの、本気で、絶対、裏話、絶対、聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard the craziest behind-the-scenes story about my favorite YouTuber. You won't believe it.
lines.style: Animated, eager voice. Quick pace building momentum. Eyes bright. The rhythm of a kid who can't wait to share. Breathless at the end, waiting for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、夜行、絶対、列車、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、乗りに行く?本気で
lines.en: Hey Sho, would you want to go ride the night train with your dad sometime? I think you'd really love it.
lines.style: Warm suggestion, not pressure. Opening word gentle and inviting. Slight rise at the question. Steady pace. Voice carrying the image of the two of them on that train together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お料理の、本気で、絶対、見栄え、絶対、いつもきれいだね
lines.en: Mei-sis, your cooking always looks so beautiful. Like, every single time.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine observation. Not flattery — noticing. Soft voice, steady pacing. The tone of someone saying something true that he's been holding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新春、絶対、お正月、絶対、楽しみね
lines.en: I'm looking forward to New Year's with you, Sho. It'll be really special.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful opening. Slow, measured pace. Warm undercurrent. Voice carrying something deeper — not just excitement, but affection. Soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、旅客機、絶対、乗ってみたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to ride on an airplane someday. Like, actually go up in one.
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. Slow, dreamy pace on the opening. Slight acceleration as the wish crystallizes. Small, genuine longing at the close. Not whining — just honest wanting.
